songs.prompt: Warm, charming background music for a cute fantasy card game: a small lantern-lit night market at dusk, where a cheerful traveling merchant sells magical ingredients from her wooden stall. Accordion melody, mandolin tremolo, nylon guitar, soft hand percussion, upright bass, a little glockenspiel. Gentle waltz in 3/4, D minor with bright moments in F major, 96 BPM, steady tempo. Slightly exotic, cozy and a bit mysterious, never scary. About 2 minutes long, with an A section and a B section that keep the same tempo, key and energy from start to end. Loopable game BGM with consistent energy, no fade-out. Instrumental only, no vocals.
